title: Echo
description: An Advance Recon Commando in the Grand Army of the Republic, Echo was presumed dead during the Citadel raid. Later, Echo turned up alive and outfitted with cybernetic enhancements. The Bad Batch rescued him from the Galactic Empire, and he joined their team. Though traumatized by the things that have happened to him, Echo found a true place as a reliable member of the squad.
